Support vector regression.

Fits epsilon-insensitive kernel support vector regression on the selected device (scikit-learn's SVR) and appends a numeric prediction column.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `SVMRegressor` |
| Search words | svm, svr, support, vector, kernel, regression, classic ml |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table with numeric features and a numeric target column |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Predictions** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table plus prediction column |
| **Model** | Parameters | No | 1 | Fitted SVR (support vectors, coefficients and kernel) |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Columns | Target column | `target_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Numeric target column in the input table. Required. |
| Columns | Feature columns | `feature_cols` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated numeric features; empty auto-detects numeric columns except the target. |
| Output | Prediction column | `prediction_col` | Text | `prediction` |   | The run | Name of the appended prediction column. |
| Artifact | Save model path | `model_path` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | JSON path to save the fitted model; empty saves it in the project's artifacts. |
| Model | Regularisation (C) | `C` | Number | `1.0` |   | The run | Penalty for errors beyond epsilon; smaller is smoother. |
| Model | Epsilon | `epsilon` | Number | `0.1` |   | The run | Errors smaller than this cost nothing (the width of the tube) |
| Model | Kernel | `kernel` | Choice | `rbf` | `rbf`, `linear`, `poly`, `sigmoid` | The run | Similarity between rows. |
| Model | Gamma | `gamma` | Text | `scale` |   | The run | Kernel coefficient for rbf, poly and sigmoid: scale (1 / (features x variance)), auto (1 / features) or a positive number. |
| Model | Degree | `degree` | Integer | `3` |   | The run | Power of the poly kernel. |
| Model | Coef0 | `coef0` | Number | `0.0` |   | The run | Constant term of the poly and sigmoid kernels. |
| Model | Tolerance | `tol` | Number | `1e-3` |   | The run | Stop when the largest optimality violation is below this. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
